text:
Beloved images of Athens.

In the Plaka district,
near Monastiraki,
an ordinary street with many shops.

If anyone who loves me
ever goes to Greece
and passes through there, especially in summer,
let them commend me to it.

It was a Monday in August,
after a terrible year; I had just arrived.
I remember suddenly loving life
because the street smelled
of cooking and shoe leather.

translation.title: Beloved Images of Athens...
